subtitle: Your online store platform
connect_desc: You approve access in your Edinio dashboard, no keys to copy. Hontrio reads your catalog (exactly the offers sent to Merchant Center) and your orders with their source, so it knows which products to promote and which sales the ads brought.
connect_note: Hontrio never receives your shoppers' personal data and cannot change anything in your store.
first_sync: The first sync is running. It can take a few minutes.
revoked_desc: Hontrio's access was stopped from Edinio. Reconnect the store so syncing can continue.
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the Edinio store? Hontrio's access is also stopped in Edinio, and the synced offers and orders are deleted from Hontrio.
connected_success: Your Edinio store is connected. The first sync has started.
error_access_denied: You canceled the connection in Edinio.
error_state: The connection session expired. Please try again.
error_expired: The connection code expired or was already used. Please try again.
error_store_exists: You already have a store connected. Disconnect it before connecting Edinio.
error_store_read: We could not read your store data from Edinio. Please try again.
error_save: We could not save the store. Please try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_not_configured: Connecting to Edinio isn’t available right now. Please contact support.
error_generic: Connecting to Edinio failed. Please try again.
